subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.din16798@1` is this plugin's own self-contained DIN EN 16798 indoor-environment document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-annex, change-occupancy, change-comfort-category, change-t-op-c, change-rh-percent, change-air-speed-ms, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
